_comment: Data/Content/weeks/week-<n>/day-<n>.json - ONE day of the course, written by hand. A day has UP TO 4 parts, and nothing downstream may assume four.

title._comment: The day's title, shown in the week menu and the course index.

locked._comment: true for a day that is written but not open yet. The UI shows it greyed and refuses to open it.

parts._comment: 1 to 4, in order. Each part is one tab of the day.

kind._comment: prerequisite = a language primer. concept = a lesson that teaches the tool. practice = practice problems.

tab_label._comment: The text on the part's tab.

has_runnable_code._comment: false when the part has no code to run. Drives the editor's empty state.

blocks._comment: Ordered content blocks, in DOCUMENT ORDER. Markdown blocks render as prose; example blocks get a 'Load into editor' button; your-turn blocks render as a 'Try it' callout; a problem-ref block marks where a practice problem sits, its text being the problem number. at-a-glance opens a lesson, and checkpoint and recap close it; all three render as cards.

text._comment: Markdown source for a markdown block; TypeScript source for example and your-turn blocks; the problem number as a string for problem-ref; markdown for at-a-glance and recap; the question itself for a checkpoint.

starter._comment: your-turn ONLY: runnable code that 'Try it' loads into the editor, so the learner never starts from a bare comment. null for every other block type.

variation._comment: your-turn ONLY: the prompt the learner reads. null for every other block type.

checkpoint._comment: checkpoint ONLY: the options, the answer and why. Formative and never scored - nothing is written to progress, so a wrong answer costs only the reading. null for every other block type.

options._comment: 2-5 answers. Every one has to be defensible from the lesson's own text.

explanation._comment: Shown after answering, right or wrong - the reason, not just the verdict.

problems._comment: Present ONLY on a practice part. The count is not fixed.

statement._comment: Markdown: what to build, where, and how you will know it worked.

stub._comment: What 'Start this in the editor' loads.

solution._comment: Model answer in MARKDOWN, revealed on a deliberate click. Code answers carry their own fence. null = not written, and the reveal button is absent rather than broken.
